1#B#1.B#Puruṣasūktam#oṃ taccha̱ṃ yorāvṛ̍ṇīmahe
gā̱tuṃ ya̱jñāya̍
gā̱tuṃ ya̱jñapa̍taye
daivī̎ sva̱stira̍stu naḥ
sva̱stirmānu̍ṣebhyaḥ
ū̱rdhvaṃ ji̍gātu bheṣa̱jam
śanno̍ astu dvi̱pade̎
śaṃ catu̍ṣpade
oṃ śānti̱ḥ śānti̱ḥ śānti̍ḥ
hariḥ oṃ
##

1#1#1.1#Puruṣasūktam#oṃ sa̱hasra̍śīrṣā̱ puru̍ṣaḥ
sa̱ha̱srā̱kṣaḥ sa̱hasra̍pāt
sa bhūmi̍ṃ vi̱śvato̍ vṛ̱tvā
atya̍tiṣṭhaddaśāṅgu̱lam
##

1#2#1.2#Puruṣasūktam#puru̍ṣa e̱vedaṃ sarva̎m
yadbhū̱taṃ yacca̱ bhavya̎m
u̱tāmṛ̍ta̱tvasyeśā̍naḥ
yadanne̍nāti̱roha̍ti
##

1#3#1.3#Puruṣasūktam#e̱tāvā̍nasya mahi̱mā
ato̱ jyāyā̍ṃśca̱ pūru̍ṣaḥ
pādo̎’sya̱ viśvā̍ bhū̱tāni̍
tri̱pāda̍syā̱mṛta̍ṃ di̱vi
##

1#4#1.4#Puruṣasūktam#tri̱pādū̱rdhva udai̱tpuru̍ṣaḥ
pādo̎’sye̱hā’’bha̍vā̱tpuna̍ḥ
tato̱ viśva̱ṅvya̍krāmat
sā̱śa̱nā̱na̱śa̱ne a̱bhi
##

1#5#1.5#Puruṣasūktam#tasmā̎dvi̱rāḍa̍jāyata
vi̱rājo̱ adhi̱ pūru̍ṣaḥ
sa jā̱to atya̍ricyata
pa̱ścādbhūmi̱matho̍ pu̱raḥ
##

1#6#1.6#Puruṣasūktam#yatpuru̍ṣeṇa ha̱viṣā̎
de̱vā ya̱jñamata̍nvata
va̱sa̱nto a̍syāsī̱dājya̎m
grī̱ṣma i̱dhmaḥ śa̱raddha̱viḥ
##

1#7#1.7#Puruṣasūktam#sa̱ptāsyā̍sanpari̱dhaya̍ḥ
triḥ sa̱pta sa̱midha̍ḥ kṛ̱tāḥ
de̱vā yadya̱jñaṃ ta̍nvā̱nāḥ
aba̍dhna̱npu̍ruṣaṃ pa̱śum
##

1#8#1.8#Puruṣasūktam#taṃ ya̱jñaṃ ba̱rhiṣi̱ praukṣa̍n
puru̍ṣaṃ jā̱tama̍gra̱taḥ
tena̍ de̱vā aya̍janta
sā̱dhyā ṛṣa̍yaśca̱ ye
##

1#9#1.9#Puruṣasūktam#tasmā̎dya̱jñātsa̍rva̱huta̍ḥ
saṃbhṛ̍taṃ pṛṣadā̱jyam
pa̱śūṃstāṃśca̍kre vāya̱vyā̍n
ā̱ra̱ṇyāngrā̱myāśca̱ ye
##

1#10#1.10#Puruṣasūktam#tasmā̎dya̱jñātsa̍rva̱huta̍ḥ
ṛca̱ḥ sāmā̍ni jajñire
chandā̍ṃsi jajñire̱ tasmā̎t
yaju̱stasmā̍dajāyata
##

1#11#1.11#Puruṣasūktam#tasmā̱daśvā̍ ajāyanta
ye ke co̍bha̱yāda̍taḥ
gāvo̍ ha jajñire̱ tasmā̎t
tasmā̎jjā̱tā a̍jā̱vaya̍ḥ
##

1#12#1.12#Puruṣasūktam#yatpuru̍ṣa̱ṃ vya̍dadhuḥ
ka̱ti̱dhā vya̍kalpayan
mukha̱ṃ kima̍sya̱ kau bā̱hū
kāvū̱rū pādā̍vucyete
##

1#13#1.13#Puruṣasūktam#brā̱hma̱ṇo̎’sya̱ mukha̍māsīt
bā̱hū rā̍ja̱nya̍ḥ kṛ̱taḥ
ū̱rū tada̍sya̱ yadvaiśya̍ḥ
pa̱dbhyāṃ śū̱dro a̍jāyata
##

1#14#1.14#Puruṣasūktam#ca̱ndramā̱ mana̍so jā̱taḥ
cakṣo̱ḥ sūryo̍ ajāyata
mukhā̱dindra̍ścā̱gniśca̍
prā̱ṇādvā̱yura̍jāyata
##

1#15#1.15#Puruṣasūktam#nābhyā̍ āsīda̱ntari̍kṣam
śī̱rṣṇo dyauḥ sama̍vartata
pa̱dbhyāṃ bhūmi̱rdiśa̱ḥ śrotrā̎t
tathā̍ lo̱kāṃ a̍kalpayan
##

1#16#1.16#Puruṣasūktam#vedā̱hame̱taṃ puru̍ṣaṃ ma̱hānta̎m
ā̱di̱tyava̍rṇa̱ṃ tama̍sa̱stu pā̱re
sarvā̍ṇi rū̱pāṇi̍ vi̱citya̱ dhīra̍ḥ
nāmā̍ni kṛ̱tvā’bhi̱vada̱n yadāste̎
##

1#17#1.17#Puruṣasūktam#dhā̱tā pu̱rastā̱dyamu̍dāja̱hāra̍
śa̱kraḥ pravi̱dvānpra̱diśa̱ścata̍sraḥ
tame̱vaṃ vi̱dvāna̱mṛta̍ i̱ha bha̍vati
nānyaḥ panthā̱ aya̍nāya vidyate
##

1#18#1.18#Puruṣasūktam#ya̱jñena̍ ya̱jñama̍yajanta de̱vāḥ
tāni̱ dharmā̍ṇi pratha̱mānyā̍san
te ha̱ nāka̍ṃ mahi̱māna̍ḥ sacante
yatra̱ pūrve̍ sā̱dhyāḥ santi̍ de̱vāḥ
oṃ namo nārā̍yaṇā̱ya
##

1#19#1.19#Puruṣasūktam#a̱dbhyaḥ saṃbhū̍taḥ pṛthi̱vyai rasā̎cca
vi̱śvaka̍rmaṇa̱ḥ sama̍varta̱tādhi̍
tasya̱ tvaṣṭā̍ vi̱dadha̍drū̱pame̍ti
tatpuru̍ṣasya̱ viśva̱mājā̍na̱magre̎
##

1#20#1.20#Puruṣasūktam#vedā̱hame̱taṃ puru̍ṣaṃ ma̱hānta̎m
ā̱di̱tyava̍rṇa̱ṃ tama̍sa̱ḥ para̍stāt
tame̱vaṃ vi̱dvāna̱mṛta̍ i̱ha bha̍vati
nānyaḥ panthā̍ vidya̱te’ya̍nāya
##

1#21#1.21#Puruṣasūktam#pra̱jāpa̍tiścarati̱ garbhe̍ a̱ntaḥ
a̱jāya̍māno bahu̱dhā vijā̍yate
tasya̱ dhīrā̱ḥ pari̍jānanti̱ yoni̎m
marī̍cīnāṃ pa̱dami̍cchanti ve̱dhasa̍ḥ
##

1#22#1.22#Puruṣasūktam#yo de̱vebhya̱ āta̍pati
yo de̱vānā̎ṃ pu̱rohi̍taḥ
pūrvo̱ yo de̱vebhyo̍ jā̱taḥ
namo̍ ru̱cāya̱ brāhma̍ye
##

1#23#1.23#Puruṣasūktam#ruca̍ṃ brā̱hmam ja̱naya̍ntaḥ
de̱vā agre̱ tada̍bruvan
yastvai̱vaṃ brā̎hma̱ṇo vi̱dyāt
tasya̍ de̱vā asa̱n vaśe̎
##

1#24#1.24#Puruṣasūktam#hrīśca̍ te la̱kṣmīśca̱ patnyau̎
a̱ho̱rā̱tre pā̱rśve
nakṣa̍trāṇi rū̱pam
a̱śvinau̱ vyātta̎m
i̱ṣṭaṃ ma̍niṣāṇa
a̱muṃ ma̍niṣāṇa
sarva̍ṃ maniṣāṇa
##

gā̱tuṃ ya̱jñapa̍taye
daivī̎ sva̱stira̍stu naḥ
sva̱stirmānu̍ṣebhyaḥ
ū̱rdhvaṃ ji̍gātu bheṣa̱jam
śanno̍ astu dvi̱pade̎
śaṃ catu̍ṣpade
oṃ śānti̱ḥ śānti̱ḥ śānti̍ḥ
